Name: Complement Birdie (Custom NPC)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=6]"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11731]Birdie Hut Interior[/url]﻿" is
always required for this mod to work.[/size][/color][/center]

Add a schedule to Birdie to make it a giftable NPC.
Event scenes will be added. (Currently there is only one.)
The accompanying dialogue will be added.

Changes will take effect the day after Birdie's quest is completed.
(If you use this mod with data that has already completed that quest, the changes will take effect from the date you load it.)

Birdie fishes his usual spot in the morning.
In the afternoon, he walks around IslandWest.
(The point we head to is random depending on the day.)
(If you talk to them when they are at this particular point, they will engage in a dialogue specific to that location.)
On rainy days, I stay inside all day.

We have plans to add further dialogue and event scenes, but it is not clear at this time if we will make that update.

[color=#00ffff][size=4]Birdie schedule details[/size][/color].
[spoiler]  6:00~  Birdie is in front of the kitchen (coconut) in the house.
  9:00~  Birdie is fishing at his usual spot.
13:30~  Birdie will move to various locations in IslandWest on a daily basis.
(We are looking at the bushes next to the house, in front of the QiRoom, in front of the slime zone, fishing in the pond, fishing on the beach, in front of the shipwreck, and the Island Farmhouse.)
(Also, if you are in one of these locations, you will have an added dialogue.)
17:00~  Birdie is in front of the kitchen (coconut) in the house.
20:00~  Birdie is in front of Locket in the house.
23:00~  Birdie sleeps in bed.

On rainy days, I stay inside all day.[/spoiler]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]More about Birdie's gift preferences.[/size][/color]
[spoiler]These are Birdie-specific love gifts and like gifts.
Love:  Mango, Poi, Tuna, Treasure Chest, Ginger Ale.
Like: Super Cucumber, Fairy Dust, Banana,  Ginger.[/spoiler]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]Heart Event Details.[/size][/color]
[spoiler][color=#ffff00]Heart 3 event scene.[/color]
Occurrence Conditions
･ Birdie has 3 or more hearts.
･ It is not a festival day.
･ Ginger Island is sunny.
･ Time is 6:00~17:00.
If you enter IslandWest (Island Farm) in this state, an event will occur.[/spoiler]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]Special Orders Details.[/size][/color]
[spoiler][color=#ffff00]Special orders will be added after seeing the Heart 3 event.[/color]
･Deliver 50 pieces of hard wood to Birdie's house.
The reward will be friendship points for the birdie and a letter.
Also, clearing this special order is a condition for the next event scene that will be added later.[/spoiler]
[color=#00ffff][size=4]Mail from Birdie.[/size][/color]
Earn many hearts and watch events to receive gift and request mails from birdie.


[color=#00ff00][size=4]Compatibility with other mods.[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Compatible with other mods that change Birdie portraits.[/*]
[*]It is partially incompatible with other mods that change Birdie sprites.[/*]
[/list](I have no problem with the mod working itself, but I think the textures look odd when Birdie is fishing. We may be able to add compatibility for this, so please send us a request on the POSTS page.)
